questions.title: Who will win the men's singles title at the 2026 US Open?
questions.background: The US Open is one of tennis's four Grand Slam tournaments and is played on hard courts in New York.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official US Open results identifying the 2026 men's singles champion. Resolution Timing : Resolve when the men's singles final concludes and the champion is officially confirmed in September 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The winning player's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-08-27 double shock (mixed-doubles rust + asymmetric US Open draw): (1) Carlos Alcaraz plunged 9 points on Polymarket (35% -> 26% pre-draw, Daily Beast Aug 27; DraftKings post-draw +250 ~24% vig-free) after appearing rusty in his Aug 25 mixed doubles QF exit following 133 days out, AND drew the brutal bottom-half gauntlet today: Roman Safiullin (Wimbledon R4) in R1, Brooksby R2, Paul/Bublik R4, Shelton/Fils QF, Djokovic SF, and Zverev F—cutting Alcaraz 0.35 -> 0.245. (2) Top seed Alexander Zverev rises 0.205 -> 0.235 (Polymarket 22% pre-draw, DK +300) after inheriting the vastly softer top half (Sonego R1, Musetti R4, De Minaur/Jodar QF, Auger-Aliassime/Cobolli/Fritz SF), avoiding Alcaraz, Djokovic, Shelton, Fils, Medvedev, and Tiafoe until the final. (3) Novak Djokovic nudges 0.10 -> 0.11 (Polymarket 11%, DK +700) with a playable path to the SF via Navone, Berrettini/Wawrinka, Nakashima/Rublev, and slumping Medvedev/Tiafoe. (4) Ben Shelton trims 0.075 -> 0.07 (DK +900, Polymarket 8% pre-draw, offset by a brutal Q4 path: Griekspoor R1, Hurkacz R2, Arthur Fils R4, Alcaraz QF, Djokovic SF). (5) Taylor Fritz (0.065, DK +1200) enters #5 replacing Arthur Fils (~0.055): Fritz (2024 finalist, Washington champ, 8-2 summer) is the biggest draw beneficiary in soft Q2 (Cerundolo R3, Cobolli R4, Auger-Aliassime/Tien/Mensik QF, avoiding the bottom-half bloodbath until the final), whereas Fils faces Tsitsipas R1, Lehecka R3, Shelton R4, Alcaraz QF, and Djokovic SF. Top-5 sum = 0.725, leaving 27.5% for Fils (~0.055), Rafael Jodar (~0.035), Tiafoe, Auger-Aliassime, Mensik, Medvedev, De Minaur, and the field.

questions.title: Who will win the women's singles title at the 2026 US Open?
questions.background: The US Open is an annual Grand Slam tennis tournament played on hard courts in New York.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official US Open tournament results, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the player officially declared the women's singles champion following completion of the 2026 US Open final. Accepted Answer Format : The champion's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Recalibrating to Aug 27 FanDuel odds (vig-free Top-5 sum = 0.600 vs our prior 0.680 overconcentration) and today's heavily lopsided women's singles draw: (1) Two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka holds near steady (0.215 -> 0.21): FanDuel +340 (~0.189 vig-free pre-draw) gets a ~+0.02 boost from landing in the much softer top half (Osorio R1, Krejcikova R3, Shnaider R4, Wimbledon champ Linda Noskova QF, Pegula/Muchova SF), avoiding Gauff, Swiatek, Rybakina, Osaka, and Andreeva until the final, balanced against her 17-7 post-March slump. (2) Cincinnati champion Coco Gauff trims 0.16 -> 0.14 (FanDuel +490 ~0.136 vig-free) as Q3/bottom half is loaded (Bejlek R3, Eala/Jovic R4, Mirra Andreeva/Anisimova QF, Swiatek/Rybakina/Osaka SF), though Gauff's 5-0 H2H vs Andreeva and dominant serving keep her #2. (3) Iga Swiatek drops 0.15 -> 0.125 (FanDuel +480 ~0.139 vig-free pre-draw) after #8 seeding landed her in the Q4 quarter of death with Bencic/Keys R4 and Rybakina/Osaka QF. (4) Jessica Pegula (0.075 -> 0.065, rising to #4; FanDuel +1400 ~0.048 vig-free pre-draw) benefits massively from the wide-open Q2 (Muchova/Svitolina QF) avoiding the entire bottom half until the final. (5) Naomi Osaka trims 0.08 -> 0.06 (FanDuel +1000 ~0.068 vig-free pre-draw) due to her brutal Q4 path (Rybakina R4, Swiatek QF, Gauff SF). Top-5 sum = 0.600, leaving 40% for Elena Rybakina (~0.055; Achilles tear ruled out and practiced Thursday, but leg recovery, Q4 of death, and 0 career US Open QFs weigh heavily), Mirra Andreeva (~0.045, 0-5 vs Gauff), Anisimova, Kostyuk, Muchova, Noskova, Eala, and the deep WTA field.

questions.title: Which U.S. player will advance furthest in men's singles at the 2026 US Open?
questions.background: This question concerns the men's singles main draw, excluding qualifying.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official US Open results or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the 2026 tournament. Resolution : Identify the player representing the United States with the highest tournament finish. The champion ranks above the runner-up, followed by semifinalists, quarterfinalists, and earlier-round finishers. Resolve once no remaining match can change the identity of the uniquely highest-finishing U.S. player. Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-08-27 draw inversion flips Taylor Fritz clearly ahead of Ben Shelton as the favorite to be the furthest-advancing U.S. man (confirmed by 128-player bracket Monte Carlo across Elo sensitivity scenarios): (1) Taylor Fritz (#9 seed) jumps 0.25 -> 0.31 after landing in the softest quarter (Q2: Cerundolo R3, #5 Flavio Cobolli R4, #3 Auger-Aliassime/Tien/Mensik QF), avoiding Zverev until SF and Alcaraz/Djokovic/Shelton/Fils until the final (sim P(QF+) ~44%, P(SF+) ~31%). (2) Ben Shelton (#8 seed) plunges 0.34 -> 0.22 after drawing Q4's gauntlet of death: Tallon Griekspoor R1, Hubert Hurkacz/Dzumhur R2, Norrie/Kecmanovic R3, Cincinnati champ #10 Arthur Fils R4, #2 Carlos Alcaraz QF, and #4 Novak Djokovic SF. (3) Frances Tiafoe (#11 seed) holds strong at 0.18 in Q3 with a very playable path through Vacherot (R3) and slumping #7 Daniil Medvedev (R4) to face Djokovic in QF (sim P(QF+) ~32.5%). (4) #14 seed Learner Tien enters #4 at 0.08 in the softer Q2 (Monfils R2, Mensik R3, shaky Auger-Aliassime R4, avoiding Zverev until SF), displacing Brandon Nakashima (#16, ~0.065) who drew Rublev R3 and Djokovic R4. (5) #20 seed Tommy Paul trims 0.09 -> 0.07 facing Bublik R3 and rusty Alcaraz R4 in Q4. Top-5 sum = 0.86, leaving 14% for Nakashima (~0.065), Alex Michelsen (~0.025), and unseeded U.S. entrants.

questions.title: Which Brazilian Supreme Court justice, if any, will order Federal Police chief Andrei Rodrigues suspended during September 2026?
questions.background: Brazil’s Federal Police investigates federal crimes, and its leadership can be subject to judicial orders.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public orders from Brazil’s Supreme Federal Court or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations identifying the justice responsible. Resolution Conditions : Identify the justice who issues an order during September 2026 suspending Andrei Rodrigues from his position as Federal Police chief. If multiple qualifying orders are issued, use the earliest publicly announced order. Accepted Answer Format : The justice’s full name. If no qualifying order is issued by September 30, 2026, answer “None”.
questions.current_reasoning: Breaking Aug 27 G1 and O Globo reports confirm two countervailing dynamics right ahead of September: (1) Tensions between STF Justice Andre Mendonca and PF Director-General Andrei Rodrigues worsened in recent days ('o clima piorou nos ultimos dias') following newly revealed messages in the Lulinha influence-peddling probe, with Mendonca—sole rapporteur across Banco Master, INSS fraud, Dark Horse, and two Lulinha inquiries—suspecting Rodrigues of using PF command to obstruct probes. (2) President Lula personally intervened on Aug 27 to arrange a direct truce meeting between Rodrigues and Mendonca (mediated by Justice Minister Wellington Cesar Lima e Silva, while AGU Jorge Messias continues avoiding formal legal challenges in favor of a political off-ramp), though no date has been set yet. Because virtually all suspension risk sits exclusively with Mendonca rather than other STF justices, we trim Gilmar Mendes (0.05 -> 0.025), Alexandre de Moraes (0.04 -> 0.025), and Dias Toffoli (0.03 -> 0.015), lifting None (0.48 -> 0.51) on active presidential mediation and raising Andre Mendonca (0.37 -> 0.41) to reflect his overwhelming share of conditional suspension risk.

questions.title: Which company will Liverpool announce as its main shirt sponsor for the 2027–28 season?
questions.background: Standard Chartered has been Liverpool's main shirt sponsor since 2010. This sponsorship gives the company prominent branding on the front of the club's playing shirts.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Liverpool FC's official announcement identifying the company with an agreed main front-of-shirt sponsorship deal covering the 2027–28 season. Resolution Timing : Resolve when the club announces the agreement, provided the announcement occurs between June 1 and December 31, 2026. The agreement's announcement, rather than the sponsorship's commencement, determines resolution. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the sponsoring company. Sleeve sponsors, kit manufacturers, and other commercial partners do not qualify.
questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-08-21 to 2026-08-25 update (SportBusiness, Footy Headlines, Liverpool.com, Football Insider): Standard Chartered's exclusive renewal negotiation window EXPIRED without a renewal offer after the bank signed a major global Formula 1 sponsorship earlier in 2026, while Liverpool are seeking >£60m-£70m/yr (up from £50m) and are reportedly in advanced talks with alternative global brands outside their usual partner categories. Consequently, Standard Chartered plunges 0.20 -> 0.07 (retained as narrow #1 individual company only because a late compromise return is not completely ruled out in a challenging EPL sponsorship market). AXA (0.07 -> 0.06, existing principal training partner), Riyadh Air (0.05 -> 0.04), Qatar Airways (0.04 -> 0.035), and Amazon (0.04 -> 0.03; Daily Mail and Stefan Borson downplayed an Amazon shirt deal despite Jeff Bezos's 1892 Holdings 38% stake, expecting Bezos/Bhatia/Saverin contacts to source an external global partner, though a fair-market APT deal remains nonzero) round out the Top 5. Total Top-5 probability drops 0.40 -> 0.235, properly leaving 76.5% on the wide global corporate field (fintech/crypto, tech, airlines, banks, conglomerates) ahead of the 2026-09-08 resolution window.

questions.title: What immigration status will the Trump administration seek to require for noncitizens to be included in the 2030 US census?
questions.background: The decennial US census affects representation in the House of Representatives and the allocation of federal funding. Trump has previously advocated changing which immigrants are counted.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official Department of Commerce proposal, or reliable contemporaneous reporting explicitly describing its eligibility rules for the 2030 census. Resolution Conditions : Resolve upon the administration's next formal proposal specifying eligibility for the 2030 census, provided it is published by September 30, 2026. Identify the immigration status the proposal requires noncitizens to hold to be included. Publication is sufficient; implementation or judicial approval is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the required immigration status, in one to three words.
questions.current_reasoning: Major update based on leaked Department of Commerce/Census Bureau 2030 proposed residence criteria rule submitted to OMB on June 25 and obtained by Wired (Aug 8) and Talking Points Memo (Aug 11, analyzed by CityLand Aug 17 and The Nation Aug 19). The circulated draft explicitly states that only lawful permanent residents (alongside narrow humanitarian carveouts for approved asylees and approved refugees) would be counted among noncitizens, excluding undocumented immigrants as well as temporary visa holders (foreign students, H-1B workers, TPS, DACA). This strongly elevates 'Lawful permanent resident' (0.35 -> 0.65) and slashes broader categories like 'Lawful status' (0.13) and 'Lawful presence' (0.08), while remaining capped at 0.65 because the text is still an OMB review draft that could be revised or delayed prior to formal Federal Register publication.

questions.title: Which Ukrainian city away from the eastern and southern front lines will experience repeated Russian strikes on fuel stations by September 11, 2026?
questions.background: Russian attacks have repeatedly hit fuel stations near Ukraine’s eastern and southern battle lines. The spread of this targeting pattern to cities farther from the fighting would broaden its impact on civilians.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Ukrainian municipal statements and reliable contemporaneous reporting citing local authorities. Resolution Conditions : Identify the Ukrainian city outside the eastern and southern frontline areas where Russian attacks are confirmed to have directly struck fuel stations on at least two separate days between September 1 and September 11, 2026. Reports of isolated attacks or incidental damage to nearby stations do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the city.
questions.current_reasoning: An Aug 4 NDTV/CNN report ('Russia Has A New Target In Ukraine War: Gas Stations Across Kyiv') confirms Russia's fuel-station drone campaign intensified to over 200 strikes in June-July (~3/day), heavily hitting frontline Zaporizhzhia (54 strikes in 24 days, excluded as a southern frontline city) while specifically spotlighting drone and airstrike attacks on gas stations around Kyiv as the top non-frontline target. Since the qualifying window (Sept 1-11, 2026) has not yet opened, we make a modest upward adjustment to Kyiv (0.26 -> 0.30) and trim Dnipro slightly (0.09 -> 0.08), leaving 24% across other rear cities (Lviv, Kremenchuk, Cherkasy, Vinnytsia, Kryvyi Rih) or non-occurrence.
